actions.label: Unlock vault
actions.summary: Derive the vault key locally, then refresh session and sync ciphertext.
typical_requests: POST /api/account/unlock/challenge + POST /api/account/unlock (SRP proofs only — empty vault / account proof)
actions.measurement_note: Checked against client source (static analysis). Confirm in DevTools.

actions.label: Open a note
actions.summary: Load decrypted content from this device; no server read of note bodies.
actions.sends_nothing_caveat: Switching away from another note with unsaved edits may push ciphertext first.
actions.measurement_note: Checked: openNote has no direct /api/ calls (switching notes may flush/sync first).

actions.label: Edit + save
actions.summary: Autosave encrypts in the browser, then pushes ciphertext envelopes.
actions.measurement_note: Checked against client source (static analysis). Confirm in DevTools.

actions.label: View server copy
actions.summary: Fetch one stored row exactly as the API keeps it (metadata + ciphertext).
actions.measurement_note: Checked against client source (static analysis). Confirm in DevTools.

actions.label: Idle (vault unlocked)
actions.summary: Background poll while you are not editing; may pull when the server watermark moves.
typical_requests: POST /api/sync/pull (only when watermark advances or dirty items exist)
POST /api/sync/items (when local edits are still dirty)
actions.measurement_note: Checked against client source (static analysis). Confirm in DevTools.

actions.label: Lock vault
actions.summary: Flush pending ciphertext, drop keys from memory, keep optional locked sync.
typical_requests: POST /api/sync/pull / push while locked (ciphertext only, when enabled)
actions.sends_nothing_caveat: No requests when there is nothing dirty and background locked-sync is quiet.
actions.measurement_note: Checked against client source (static analysis). Confirm in DevTools.
